name: Tako
headline: Tako: Twitter Bot Automation
short_description: Tako is a Twitter bot that selectively retweets/favorites based on Twitter content that the bot finds useful. You can curate Tako's behavior and constraints from a comfortable user-interface that runs right in your browser.
author: a3r0id

sections.overview:
Tako is a Twitter bot that automates engagement by selectively retweeting and favoriting content based on your configured rules. It offers three core features: Query Bot searches for tweets using hashtags you specify, Stream Bot monitors specific users for real-time interaction, and Tweet Scheduler posts content at scheduled times. Tako provides filtering options to exclude low-quality content, customizable engagement thresholds based on retweets and likes, and built-in analytics to track bot performance and follower growth. The bot runs locally with a clean browser-based interface, making it accessible for Twitter users seeking to grow their audience systematically.
Build followers by automatically engaging with relevant hashtag-based content
Monitor and interact with tweets from influencers or specific accounts in real-time
Schedule tweets to post at optimal times while Tako is running
Filter spam by excluding tweets with excessive hashtags or unwanted keywords
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/a3r0id/Tako`
sections.usage:
```
Create a Twitter bot named Tako that selectively retweets and favorites content based on specific criteria. The bot should focus on [INDUSTRY] content from [COMPANY] and related accounts. Implement a user-friendly interface that allows me to adjust the bot's behavior, such as setting keywords, hashtags, and engagement rules. Ensure the bot operates within Twitter's API limits and guidelines.
```
